subject: Fix orchestrator footgun: graph WRITE ops must reject unknown task keys (no phantom nodes) + close born-ready bypass
description:
Root cause of the note-decay mis-wire (see note-mqgs5b1nrec). Two compounding defects:
(D1) configure_task / block_task / add_dependency / record_decision.wires_to accept a BARE native index ('1') and FABRICATE a phantom node instead of resolving to the canonical '<session-uuid>/N' or rejecting — while READ ops (get_task_detail / suggest_links) correctly reject 'unknown task'. Asymmetric.
(D2) The real task then sits status:ready, deps:[], blocked:null — a born-ready bypass: a wiring-write failure yields a READY (spawnable) task instead of a stuck one.

SCOPE:
1. All graph WRITE ops VALIDATE task_key against existing nodes and REJECT unknown keys ('unknown task: <key>'), symmetric with reads — eliminates phantom-node fabrication. (Optional convenience: resolve a bare native index to the CURRENT session's '<uuid>/N', else reject; reject-first is the safety floor.)
2. Born-ready guard: a task whose wiring write failed must NOT auto-enter 'ready'. Fold into the unified ingestion→embed→wire→judge→ready lifecycle (task 091a4bf1.../28) behind the judging→ready gate (task .../17). This is a NEW born-path bypass — add it to the inventory in note-mqeapqae6jf.
3. Cheap invariant/detector: flag nodes carrying edges/blocks/config but NO label/kind/native backing (phantoms); surface, never dispatch.
4. Cleanup/migration: soft-retire the existing phantom nodes '1'..'12'.
5. Tests: reject-unknown-key on EVERY write op; phantom detector; born-blocked-on-failed-wire.

Flat task — forks off main (no feature branch). Commit onto orch/attempt/<key> before complete_task.

summary: Hardened all graph WRITE ops against unknown task keys. Added nodeExistsInGraph() helper in daemon.js; threaded into /overlay/status, /overlay/block, /overlay/unblock, /overlay/edge, /overlay/edge/remove, /overlay/note (wires_to), /overlay/knowledge, /task/metric, /task/benchmark, /task/measure, /mark-root, /git/repo, /supersede — all return {ok:false, error:'unknown task: <key>'} HTTP 404 on unknown key, symmetric with READ-op guards. Added scripts/retire-phantom-nodes.js to soft-retire bare-integer phantom artefacts. Added test/unknown-key-rejection.test.js with 52 passing tests covering every hardened path. Commit: c8074a51 on orch/attempt/d42ebe37-ee9f-46b6-ae21-f6f82464d482-13.
